entries.title: Psalms 79:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance: thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

entries.title: Psalms 79:2
segments: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowl of the heavens, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth:

entries.title: Psalms 79:3
segments: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem, and there was none to bury [them].

entries.title: Psalms 79:4
segments: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a mockery and a derision to them that are round about us.

entries.title: Psalms 79:5
segments: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 79:6
segments: ¶Pour out thy fury upon the nations that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name:

entries.title: Psalms 79:7
segments: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his habitation.

entries.title: Psalms 79:8
segments: Remember not against us the iniquities of [our] forefathers; let thy tender mercies speedily come to meet us: for we are brought very low.

entries.title: Psalms 79:9
segments: Help us, O God of our salvation, because of the glory of thy name; and deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 79:10
segments: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants that is shed be known among the nations in our sight.

entries.title: Psalms 79:11
segments: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thine arm, preserve those that are appointed to die;

entries.title: Psalms 79:12
segments: And render unto our neighbours, sevenfold into their bosom, their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 79:13
segments: And we, thy people and the sheep of thy pasture, will give thanks unto thee for ever; we will shew forth thy praise from generation to generation.
